title: UbicloudSetupConfig
description: Schema for the YAML consumed by UbicloudSetup.run_ch_ubi (UBICLOUD_SETUP_YAML_PATH). Shared between the ubicloud setup.rb and the clickgres-platform helm chart values.

enabled.description: When false, run_ch_ubi is a no-op.

cleanup_default_locations.description: When true, hide_default_locations is called to hide non-clickgres locations.

pg_gce_images.description: GCE images for provisioning Postgres on GCP (the GCP analogue of pg_amis, without the region dimension; GCE images are global). Each entry is upserted into pg_gce_image, keyed by (arch, gce_image_name), with its explicit pg_versions list.

dns_server_amis.description: region -> arch AMI map for DNS server VMs.

provider.description: Cloud provider for the location. Defaults to "aws" when omitted.

role.description: AWS IAM role ARN the control plane assumes for this location. Required for aws locations.

dns_suffix.description: Per-location DNS subdomain. Required for aws locations; omitted for gcp locations, which fall back to publicly-signed certificates (DNS server provisioning is not yet supported on gcp).

gcp_project_id.description: GCP project that hosts the location's resources. Required for gcp locations.

service_account_email.description: Service account the control plane impersonates for this location. Required for gcp locations.

project_visible.description: Whether the location is enabled in the project's Postgres UI (the visible_postgres_locations feature flag). Defaults to true. Only gcp locations are gated this way; aws locations are always visible.

otel_otlp_export_endpoint.description: Deprecated. Retained for backward compatibility; ignored by setup.rb. Use otel_otlp_destination instead.

oneOf.description: AWS location: assume-role auth, requires dns_suffix.
GCP location: service-account impersonation; capacity_reservation and dns_suffix do not apply.

CapacityReservationConfig.description: Standing AWS ODCR config; only applied when enabled is true.

enabled.description: When false (default), no capacity reservation strand is created for the location.

additional_capacity.description: Buffer fraction added on top of current usage (floored at +3 per instance type). Max mirrors Prog::CapacityReservation::MAX_ADDITIONAL_CAPACITY.

enable_all_families.description: Buffer every instance type currently in use; instance_families, if also set, adds its resolved sizes on top.

allowed_capacity_decrease.description: Buffer fraction to retain over current usage when shrinking (must be >= additional_capacity); omit/null means never shrink.

reconcile_interval.description: Seconds between natural re-measure passes. Defaults to 300; floored at 60 to avoid hammering the AWS APIs.

remove_orphaned_reservations.description: If true, cancel managed ODCRs for instance types no longer eligible (e.g. removed from the config or a minimum_provisioned_* size that stopped being provisioned). When NOTHING is eligible it cancels ALL of the location's managed ODCRs (full wind-down), except during the InsufficientAZs safety path. Default false.

min_available_az_insufficient_action.description: What to do when AWS offers a type (or the whole location) in fewer than the required 3 AZs: PAGE raises an incident, WARN just logs. Default PAGE; set WARN where a needed family (e.g. Graviton4 8gd) is genuinely offered in < 3 AZs in the region.

instance_families.description: family -> constraint (exactly one of minimum_cpu / minimum_storage / sizes / minimum_provisioned_cpu / minimum_provisioned_storage). The bare minimum_* and sizes cover all matching catalog sizes (pre-warming unused ones); the minimum_provisioned_* variants cover only matching sizes currently in use.
